notes: Pseudonym rules, registration with proven device keys, status lifecycle, roles, erasure/export hooks, AccountLookup. No uniqueness check of device keys across accounts.
Challenge-response login, hashed bearer tokens, 30d absolute / 7d sliding idle expiry, list/revoke, authenticate(token) for the relay, expire_due sweeper.
Ten 80-bit single-use recovery codes (hashes only), recovery with proven new keys revokes old keys and sessions, per-account RateLimitPort, signed device add/revoke with keyEpoch replay defence.
Versioned classrup.identity document built by relay, signed by client device key; verify and key-continuity import with 30 day age window. No automatic cross-relay fetch.
Profile fields with per-field visibility (public/participants/private), coarse regionCell only, viewer-filtered DTOs, blocked viewers see nothing. Avatar is an attachment ref only.
Counterparty-verified feedback via InteractionVerifier (default deny), one per subject, 14 day edit, moderator removal, Bayesian aggregate (prior 3.5, weight 5).
Self-attested claims vs attester-signed verified evidence; trusted attester registry; revocation and expiry; public DTO shows kind and verified flag only.
